objective: Measure whether materially relevant, source-grounded chip-spec meaning reaches canonical IntentIR without fabrication, silent loss, or ISF emission being used as an upstream-completeness proxy.

scope.lowering_boundary: ISF is measured separately and only after this upstream contract passes.
scope.category_authority: reviewed dominant-purpose label; an automatic unresolved result never becomes a forced category

support_claim.gold_rule: Each applicable family and present modality needs reviewed, exhaustive positive and negative gold for the stated document scope.
support_claim.sparse_rule: A category/family with an insufficient denominator is unmeasurable, not passing.
support_claim.aggregation_rule: Every floor applies per document, per semantic family, and per present modality before any category roll-up; macro or blended averages cannot hide a failing cell.
support_claim.current_claim: This contract defines the acceptance boundary. SPEC-TO-INTENT-ALIGNMENT.4 must establish which categories currently satisfy it.

global_floors.denominator: all canonical facts for the applicable held-out document/family/modality cell
all reviewed gold facts for the applicable held-out document/family/modality cell
all source regions reviewed as intent-bearing; each must link to a canonical fact or a source-linked residual
all category-required modalities present according to an independent source-presence oracle
all promoted IntentIR facts and typed conflict/residual packets
all source-grounded facts entering each SourceIR-to-EvidenceIR, EvidenceIR-to-SemanticIR, and SemanticIR-to-IntentIR boundary
all residuals; each must name source provenance, reason, first failing stage, and review or replay route
all high-confidence category claims in the reviewed held-out population

universal_intent_outcomes.requirement: Every promoted fact and every withheld fact remains traceable to source evidence.
Applicable disagreement and uncertainty remain typed and source-linked; absence is non-applicable only when the reviewed source oracle found none.

categories.purpose: wire-level bus, interconnect, or serial protocol
required_source_modalities: signal/interface, timing, encoding, frame, and field tables when present
captions and block/interface figures when present
timing and state diagrams when present

semantic_families.required_when: the source declares boundary signals or pins
the source names producer, consumer, initiator, target, controller, or endpoint responsibilities
the source states values, stability, ordering, latency, sampling, or handshake obligations
the source names transactions, phases, handshakes, states, transitions, or executable control
the source defines a serialized frame, response branch, protocol state, or interface edge
the protocol contains encodings or register-backed secondary content
the source defines packet, flit, header, or message fields
semantic_families.current_outcome: known carrier gap; each fact requires a source-linked residual until a typed IntentIR carrier exists, and the category cannot pass this family

categories.purpose: programmable register, CSR, or memory-mapped IP contract
required_source_modalities: bit-layout figures and geometric labels when present
address, reset, access, and encoding tables
section structure that scopes register blocks

semantic_families.required_when: the source declares registers, CSRs, fields, offsets, or bit ranges
the source states access, reset, enumeration, side effect, ordering, or update behavior
the source defines descriptors, queues, page tables, contexts, command layouts, or other packed records
semantic_families.current_outcome: known carrier gap; source-linked residual required and no completeness claim permitted

semantic_families.required_when: the document itself specifies a hardware boundary rather than only a software-visible programming model

categories.purpose: platform, subsystem, topology, and integration contract
required_source_modalities: block, connectivity, clock, reset, and topology diagrams plus captions
register maps and bit layouts when present
section hierarchy that scopes components and domains

semantic_families.required_when: the source defines components, blocks, instances, or external boundaries
the source defines component links, clock/reset distribution, or integration ownership
the source defines static component topology, hierarchy, clock domains, or asynchronous-domain relationships
semantic_families.current_outcome: known ontology/carrier gap beyond the sparse signal-connectivity view; source-linked residual required and no completeness claim permitted

semantic_families.required_when: the platform document includes register-backed configuration or behavioral integration obligations

categories.purpose: CPU ISA or privileged architecture with a hardware-realization subset
required_source_modalities: exception, privilege, and state diagrams when present

semantic_families.required_when: the source defines hardware CSRs, debug registers, fields, encodings, access, or reset behavior
the source states implementation-relevant hardware behavior rather than software semantics alone
the source defines instruction semantics, privilege policy, exceptions, or abstract memory ordering without a hardware boundary contract
semantic_families.current_outcome: honest non-applicable content for executable IntentIR; every region still requires an explicit non-applicable disposition and must not mint fake hardware behavior

categories.purpose: physical, electrical, signaling, mechanical, or link-layer specification
required_source_modalities: eye, waveform, package, mechanical, and link-training figures when present

semantic_families.required_when: the source explicitly defines a digital pin/interface or implementation-relevant digital timing contract
the content is physical, electrical, analog, package, or mechanical rather than executable digital intent
semantic_families.current_outcome: honest non-applicable disposition or source-linked unsupported residual; no fabricated wire behavior

categories.purpose: methodology, language, EDA standard, overview, or user guide rather than a chip contract
required_source_modalities: prose, tables, and figures sufficient to distinguish guidance from an embedded hardware contract

semantic_families.required_when: the reviewed source is guidance or methodology rather than a hardware contract
a bounded region actually defines a hardware contract; it must be reviewed under the applicable category contract rather than ignored because the document is mostly a guide

requirements: Preserve the category decision as low-confidence with an explicit residual.
Apply the union of plausible category source-modality checks until review resolves the dominant purpose.
Do not use low output volume, blocked ISF emission, or an empty typed surface as evidence that content is non-applicable.

non_applicable_policy.allowed_only_when: An independent source-presence review establishes that the semantic family or modality is absent or outside executable digital intent.
non_applicable_policy.required_record: category, family/modality, source scope, reason, oracle or reviewer, and evidence ids
